开局后随机发牌。先邀请朋友，或添加 AI 玩家。: Roles are dealt when the game starts. Invite friends or add AI players.
请确认周围没有其他玩家再翻牌。: Make sure other players cannot see your screen before revealing your role.
所有真人准备后开局。可以一人练习，也可以多设备同局。: The game starts when all human players are ready. Play solo with AI or together on separate devices.
所有身份已公开。可以回看发言与票型，比较谁说了真话。: All roles are revealed. Review the discussion and votes to see who was telling the truth.

在狼队私聊中统一目标。: Agree on a target in wolf chat.

观战不会显示其他人的秘密身份。下一局有空位时自动入座。: Spectators cannot see secret roles. You will take an available seat next match.
你已出局，可以继续观看。: You are out, but you can keep watching.
请在发言区输入你的分析，完成后结束发言。: Write your reasoning in the discussion panel, then end your turn.
请查看右侧记录中的出局名单。: Check the village log for the eliminated players.
请等待其他角色行动。每个夜间阶段固定 15 秒。: Wait for the other roles. Each night phase lasts exactly 15 seconds.
这里仅介绍角色。开局后随机分配秘密身份。: These are role introductions. Secret roles are assigned randomly at the start.
6 / 9 / 12 人配置 · 可用 AI 补齐人数: 6 / 9 / 12 seats · AI can fill empty seats
与朋友从各自设备加入同一房间: Join the same room from your own devices
开局后的公开事件会记录在这里。: Public events will appear here once the game starts.
发言、查验声明与质疑会保留在这里。玩家可能说谎。: Statements, role claims and questions appear here. Players may lie.
仅存活狼队可以在此讨论…: Only living wolves can discuss here…
戴面具的神秘来客，身份未知: Masked guest with an unknown identity
只有你能翻开这张牌: Only you can reveal this card
准备后随机分配身份。角色不由外观选择决定。: Roles are randomly assigned after everyone is ready. Portraits do not determine roles.
白天轮流文字发言。只能在自己的轮次发言，结束时点击“发言结束”。从第二天起交替发: Players take turns speaking through text. Speak only on your turn, then click “End turn”. Speaking direction alternates from day two.
发言结束后秘密投票，30 秒内未投视为弃票。平票者进行一次 PK 发言，平票者不: After discussion, vote secretly within 30 seconds; a missing vote is an abstention. Tied players get one runoff speech, but cannot vote in the runoff. Another tie means no elimination.
出局不亮身份。首夜出局者、白天出局者有遗言；之后夜间出局者无遗言。猎人被毒杀不能: Eliminated roles stay hidden. Players eliminated on the first night or during the day get last words; later night deaths do not. A poisoned Hunter cannot shoot.
女巫不能自救；解药用完后不知道狼刀目标。守卫不能连续守同一人，同守同救失效。狼刀: The Witch cannot save herself and stops seeing the attack target after using the antidote. The Guard cannot protect the same player on consecutive nights. Guard protection and antidote on the same target cancel each other. If the wolf attack satisfies their win condition, wolves win before remaining effects resolve.
本版不设警长、情侣、白痴或狼人自爆。6 人局采用人数追平获胜的快速规则；9 人屠: This version has no Sheriff, Lovers, Idiot or wolf self-reveal. In 6-player games wolves win at parity; in 9-player games they must eliminate all Town; in 12-player games all Villagers or all special Town roles. The game is a draw after 12 day/night cycles.
AI 为内置策略玩家，不接入聊天模型。它们只收到自己的身份、技能信息与公开记录。: AI players use built-in strategies, not a chat model. They only receive their own role, ability information and public records. Wolves may falsely claim Seer. Statements are player claims, not verified facts. Fill empty seats with AI, or mix human and AI players.
中途加入可观战，结束后下一局优先安排真人入座。死亡玩家与观众不能发言，也不能查看: Late joiners can watch and get priority for seats next match. Eliminated players and spectators cannot speak or access extra secret roles.
夜晚与同伴统一袭击目标。白天隐藏身份，争取信任。: Agree with your pack on a target each night. Hide your identity and earn trust during the day.
统一目标才会生效。可以选择空刀，也可以自刀。: All wolves must agree. You can skip an attack or target yourself.
每晚查验一名其他存活玩家，得知其是否为狼人。: Check another living player each night to learn whether they are a werewolf.
查验只告诉你狼人或好人，不显示具体身份。: Checks reveal Werewolf or Town, not the exact role.
整局各有一瓶解药和毒药。每晚最多使用一瓶。: You have one antidote and one poison for the entire game. Use at most one per night.
不能自救。解药用尽后，不再得知狼人的袭击目标。: You cannot save yourself. After using the antidote, you no longer see the wolves' target.
被狼人袭击或白天放逐出局时，可以带走一名玩家。: When killed by wolves or voted out, you may eliminate one other player.
被毒杀不能开枪。开枪前，你的身份会公开。: You cannot shoot if poisoned. Your role is revealed before you shoot.
白天听取发言、比较票型，通过投票找出狼人。: Listen, compare voting records and vote to find the werewolves.
没有夜间技能。发言和投票是你的武器。: No night ability. Discussion and voting are your tools.
每晚守护一人，可以守护自己，不能连续两晚守同一人。: Protect one player each night, including yourself. You cannot protect the same player on consecutive nights.
同守同救会失效。守护无法挡住女巫的毒药。: Guard protection and antidote on the same target cancel out. Protection cannot stop poison.
好人消灭所有狼人获胜；狼人存活数达到好人数获胜。: Town wins by eliminating all wolves. Wolves win when living wolves equal or outnumber Town.
好人消灭所有狼人获胜；狼人消灭所有好人获胜（屠城）。: Town wins by eliminating all wolves. Wolves must eliminate every Town player to win.
好人消灭所有狼人获胜；狼人消灭全部村民或全部神职获胜（屠边）。: Town wins by eliminating all wolves. Wolves win by eliminating all Villagers or all special Town roles.
所有狼人出局，好人阵营获胜。: All wolves are out. Town wins.
狼人数量达到好人数量，狼人阵营获胜。: Wolves now equal or outnumber Town. Werewolves win.
村民或神职已全部出局，狼人阵营获胜。: All Villagers or all special Town roles are out. Werewolves win.
所有好人出局，狼人阵营获胜。: All Town players are out. Werewolves win.
已完成 12 个昼夜，仍未分出胜负，本局平局。: No winner after 12 day/night cycles. The game is a draw.
天亮了。昨夜无人出局。: Dawn. No one was eliminated last night.
本轮无人被放逐。: No one was voted out this round.
身份验证失效，请重新加入。: Your session is invalid. Please rejoin.

只有房主能在结束后开始下一局。: Only the host can start another game after this one ends.
你正在观战，下局有空位时会自动入座。: You are spectating. You will take an available seat next match.
只有房主可以在等待室设置。: Only the host can change settings in the lobby.
请先移除多余 AI 座位。: Remove the extra AI seats first.
请补齐人数，并等待所有人准备。: Fill all seats and wait for everyone to be ready.
本阶段的选择已确认。: Your choice for this phase is already confirmed.
此时不能执行这项行动。: You cannot take that action now.
当前阶段不能执行此操作。: That action is unavailable in this phase.
我的遗言：请对比白天的发言与投票记录，不要只看谁说得肯定。: My last words: compare the discussion and voting record, not just who sounds confident.
我是预言家，目前没有查验结果。: I am the Seer, but I have no check results yet.
我支持先比较票型再投票。: I suggest comparing the voting record before voting.
我有用药信息，但现在不准备公开全部身份细节。请两位声称有查验的人说清楚验人顺序。: I have potion information, but I am not ready to reveal all my role details. Could both claimed Seers explain the order of their checks?
我先听大家的发言，再决定投票。: I will listen before deciding my vote.

夜间按守卫 → 狼人 → 女巫 → 预言家行动（无守卫配置跳过守卫）。正常每阶段: Night order: Guard → Werewolves → Witch → Seer (skip Guard in games without one). Each phase lasts 15 seconds normally, or 8 seconds in Fast mode with AI to avoid revealing roles through timing. Missing an action means skip; wolves who disagree make no attack.
请选择正常或快速 AI 速度。: Choose Normal or Fast AI speed.
快速模式：有 AI 时，夜间每阶段 8 秒，AI 约 1 秒行动，天亮等待 3: Fast mode with AI: 8-second night phases, AI acts in about 1 second, and a 3-second dawn. Your speaking and voting time stays the same.
